verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms mise serves a live, structured llms.txt at https://mise.jdx.dev/llms.txt (HTTP 200, with a product summary and a 'Start Here' link index), so an agent can be pointed at it directly. However, the per-page markdown variant (getting-started.html.md) returns 404, so agents cannot pull clean markdown versions of individual doc pages. Missing for 10: per-page .md docs (probe 404), no evidence of an llms-full.txt or first-party guidance on agent-oriented doc consumption.
